newsitem.title: USA: Rykoff-Sexton hires adviser for unit buyer.
newsitem.headline: Rykoff-Sexton hires adviser for unit buyer.

text.p: Rykoff-Sexton Inc said Monday it has retained a financial advisor to find a buyer for its manufacturing division.

The company said the manufacturing division, which produces products for food service industry customers, is profitable and accounts for about five percent of its total annual sales of about $3.6 billion.
"The decision to explore the sale of our manufacturing division is consistent with our strategy of focusing on our core distribution business," the company said in a release.
